free_tier.stated: Free: $0, no card, no expiry, for one developer: up to 25 source-built services, 50 isolated builds a day and 5 GiB of retained images, 50,000 tool calls a month then $0.20 per thousand, 30 days of activity history, encrypted build logs and 30 days of rollback images.
free_tier.notes: Every core feature is free for one developer and the free plan has no expiry; the meter that ends it is 50,000 tool calls a month with a $0.20 per-thousand overage.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the unit is a tool call and a hosted service, not an object; retained images are capped at 5 GiB on Free and activity history is kept for 30 days

retention.stated: Free keeps 30 days of activity history and 30 days of rollback images; Team keeps activity history for life. Persistent storage is included for hosted services.

egress.terms: not published: the pricing and home pages state no outbound data allowance, price or egress quota for the hosted MCP endpoint; each service is reached as one URL behind ray.run/mcp and traffic volume is not priced on the page.

interface_detail: Clients add one Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint at https://ray.run/mcp; a CLI scaffolds, deploys and verifies TypeScript or Python source-built servers; remote MCP, OpenAPI, npm and container-image services are added from the dashboard.
tooling: the user's coding agent builds a server with npx rayrun init, npx rayrun deploy --wait uploads it, and an MCP client such as Claude, Codex, Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf or OpenCode connects to the single URL.
chaining: One endpoint fronts every connected service, so a client stores one URL and no secrets while Rayrun holds credentials; additional remote MCP, OpenAPI, npm and container services join behind the same endpoint under per-tool access rules.

limits.value: 50,000 tool calls a month on Free, then $0.20 per thousand; 100,000 tool calls per developer a month pooled on Team, then $0.20 per thousand
up to 25 source-built services, 50 isolated builds a day and 5 GiB of retained images on Free
30 days of activity history and 30 days of rollback images on Free

limits_note: The Free plan is for one developer; a team that shares services moves to $25 per developer per month, and Enterprise starts from $1,500 a month. Content scanning, definition review and per-tool allow/ask/block policies apply to every plan.
binding_note: Tool calls bind first: the $0.20 per-thousand overage starts at 50,000 calls a month, while the Free service, build and image allowances are unlikely to be reached by one developer before that.

identity_cost.detail: The sign-up page offers one route, 'Sign up with GitHub', which is a GitHub OAuth login; no card is required on Free. Hobby use starts after that login, and no phone or ID document is asked for on the sign-up page.

reliability_note: A failed build leaves the current release live and a candidate is verified before traffic moves; changed tool definitions wait for approval. Scanning excludes AWS providers unless deployment setup is done, and the free plan's activity history and rollback images expire after 30 days.
confidence_note: Prices, allowances, overage, retention and the GitHub sign-in gate are first-party text quoted from the vendor's pricing, home and sign-up pages read on 2026-11-24.
